international.title: Trump to embark on Asia trip in apparent foreign policy push before end of term
international.summary: Experts say US president may lean toward global affairs after domestic influence curtailed in midterm elections Donald Trump is embarking on his first overseas trip since his Republican party’s thumping midterm repudiation by US voters, in what may herald a renewed focus on foreign policy for the remainder of his presidency. The US president will meet his Chinese and Russian counterparts Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin for their first trilateral summit, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) forum in the Chinese city of Shenzhen. Before that, he will land in Manila in the Philippines on Tuesday for the Association of South-east Asian Nations (Asean) summit. Continue reading...
